AGENDA
  GLENDALE AUDIT COMMITTEE
  VIA TELECONFERENCE ONLY
 Welcome to the Glendale Audit Committee Meeting. If you have any agenda related questions or
 requests for assistance, call the Finance Department at (818) 548-2085 during business
 hours. Audit Committee Meetings are archived and available for viewing on the City’s website
 at https://www.glendaleca.gov/government/public-meeting-portal. Audit Reports are available for
 viewing on the following link: https://www.glendaleca.gov/government/departments/innovation-
 performance-and-audit/audit-reports.
  PLEASE TURN OFF CELLULAR PHONES WHILE INSIDE THE COUNCIL CHAMBER.
 In compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA) of 1990, auxiliary hearing aids, sign
 language translation, and Braille transcripts are available upon request. Assisted listening devices
 are available same-day upon request. At least 48 hours (or two business days) notice is required for
 requests regarding sign language translation and Braille transcription services. All documents related
 to open session items on this agenda that are received less than 72 hours prior to this meeting, and
 are public records, will be available for review in the Office of the City Clerk, 613 E. Broadway, RM
 110, Glendale, CA 91206.
 Translation services are provided for meetings through the use of bilingual staff for speakers who
 wish to utilize the service as available. Speakers should state their request by contacting the City
 Clerk’s office at (818) 548-2090, at least 24 hours prior to the scheduled meeting. Please specify
 the language for which you require translation. The exclusive use of City provided interpreters is not
 required and persons are welcome to use their own interpreter or speak in their native language.
  JANUARY 28, 2021 AT 2:00 PM

Due to the evolving situation with the COVID-19 novel coronavirus and health recommendations from
the LA County Health Department, the Glendale Audit Committee meeting will be available to the
public electronically.

Due to social distancing requirements, the public will not be able to attend the meeting. The public is
encouraged to watch and participate from the safety of their homes to practice social distancing.

The meeting can be viewed:
On local cable: Charter Cable Channel 6 and AT&T U-verse Channel 99.
Streaming Online: https://www.glendaleca.gov/government/public-meeting-portal

For public comments and questions during the meeting call (818) 937-8100.
 City staff will be submitting these questions and comments in real time to the appropriate person
during the Glendale Audit Committee meeting.

1. ROLL CALL
2. BUSINESS AGENDA
  a. Report of Recording Secretary, re: Posting of Agenda
  The Agenda for the January 28, 2021 Audit Committee Meeting was posted on Monday,
  January 25, 2021 on the bulletin board outside City Hall.
3. ORAL COMMUNICATIONS
  Discussion is limited to items not a part of this agenda. Each speaker is allowed 3 minutes. The
  Committee may question or respond to the speaker but there will be no debate or decision.
  The Audit Committee Chair may refer the matter to staff for investigation and report.
4. APPROVAL OF MINUTES
  a. Minutes of the Audit Committee meeting held on October 29, 2020.
5. ACTION ITEMS
6. REPORTS - INFORMATION
  a. Internal Audit Activity Report as of 12/31/2020 – Jessie Zhang, Internal Audit Manager
  b. Comprehensive Annual Financial Report (CAFR) and Report to the Audit Committee
  from CliftonLarsonAllen LLP – Theresa Clark, Finance Accounting Manager

8. NEW BUSINESS
9. ADJOURNMENT

CITY OF GLENDALE
  AUDIT COMMITTEE MINUTES
  January 28, 2021

Due to the ongoing COVID-19 pandemic, social distancing requirements, and health
recommendations from LA County Public Health Department, this meeting was conducted
remotely. All Audit Committee members and staff utilized video conferencing in order to virtually
participate in the meeting.

1.  ROLL CALL: 2:00 PM

  Present:  Zareh Amirian, Ed Khashadourian, Thomas O’Shaughnessy,

  Alex Parajon and Vahik Satoorian (absent)

2.  BUSINESS AGENDA:

  A.  Posting of Agenda

  The Agenda for the Audit Committee meeting of January 28, 2021 was posted on
  Monday, January 25, 2021 on the Bulletin Board outside City Hall and posted on the
  City’s website.

3.  ORAL COMMUNICATIONS:

  None.

4.  APPROVAL OF MINUTES:

  A.  Minutes of the Audit Committee meeting held on October 29, 2020

  Moved: Ed Khashadourian Second: Alex Parajon

  Vote as follows:

  Ayes: Ed Khashadourian, Thomas O’Shaughnessy, Alex Parajon, and Zareh Amirian

  Noes:

  Absent: Vahik Satoorian

5.  ACTION ITEMS:

  None.

  1
 6.  REPORTS – INFORMATION:

  Chairman Amirian requested that item 6B be taken out of order and presented first.

  B. Comprehensive Annual Financial Report (CAFR) and Report to the Audit
  Committee from Clifton Larson Allen LLP – Theresa Clark, Finance Accounting
  Manager

  Ms. Theresa Clark, Accounting Manager updated the Audit Committee on a business
  merger affecting the City’s selected external auditor. White Nelson Diehl Evans, LLP
  merged with CliftonLarsonAllen, LLP in November 2020. Despite the merger, the
  contract and audit plan with the City did not change.

  Ms. Clark then proceeded to introduce the Comprehensive Annual Financial Report
  (CAFR) for the Fiscal Year ended on June 30, 2020 by mentioning the introductory,
  financial, and statistical sections of the CAFR. Next, she introduced Ms. Daphne
  Munoz, Engagement Partner from CliftonLarsonAllen LLP, who made a more
  detailed presentation on the audit results. Ms. Munoz answered questions from the
  Audit Committee members with special regard to the significant deficiencies portion
  of the presentation which included supervision of closing procedures, construction in
  progress, and inventory. Ms. Jessie Zhang, Ms. Ani Antanesyan, and Ms. Michele
  Flynn assisted Ms. Munoz with other fund structure and inventory related questions
  from the Audit Committee members.

  A. Internal Audit Activity Report as of 12/31/2020 – Jessie Zhang, Internal Audit
  Manager

  Ms. Jessie Zhang, Internal Audit Manager, provided a report to the Audit Committee
  on the Internal Audit activity for the quarter ended on December 31, 2020. Ms. Ani
  Antanesyan, Internal Auditor, presented on the Payroll Codes Audit. Ms.
  Antanesyan, Ms. Michele Flynn, Director of Finance, and Mr. Matt Doyle, Director of
  Human Resources, answered questions from the Committee members. Next, Ms.
  Natalie Minami-Valdivia, Senior Internal Auditor, made a presentation on the
  Pandemic Response Plan Gap Analysis, an audit performed at the request of the
  Audit Committee. Ms. Natalie Minami-Valdivia, Deputy City Manager John
  Takhtalian, Fire Chief Silvio Lanzas, Deputy Fire Chief Bill Lynch, and Ms. Lucy
  Varpetian, Principal Assistant City Attorney, answered questions from the Committee
  members.

  After the audit presentations, Ms. Zhang continued presenting her activity report for
  the quarter. She covered projects in progress, continuous audits, quarterly follow-up
  status on outstanding audit issues, and advisory services and answered questions
  from the Committee members.

  2
 7.  AUDIT COMMITTEE/STAFF COMMENTS:

  Audit Committee Member O’Shaughnessy commended staff for the hard work,
  thoroughness, and consistent high quality of reports. Chairman Amirian reiterated Mr.
  O’Shaughnessy’s sentiments and thanked staff for the immense amount of work,
  preparation of the CAFR, and the insightful information on City operations brought about
  by the reports and presentations. Chairman Amirian encouraged members of the public
  to review the CAFR. Next, Chairman Amirian acknowledged the difficult year of 2020
  produced by the wake of the pandemic, its transitions, and unexpected circumstances,
  thanking all department directors, the Committee members, and staff for their continued
  work.

  Ms. Zhang commented on the tremendous level of support received from all City
  departments which have allowed Internal Audit to continue to conduct their audits. She
  offered gratitude on behalf of the Internal Audit team. Chairman Amirian raised the
  question of the outstanding issue on the fifth member of the Audit Committee, Mr. Vahik
  Satoorian, and asked for an update on his replacement due to his continued absence.
  Ms. Zhang responded that Mr. Satoorian is still considered active until such time as he is
  replaced or voluntary resigns. Ms. Varpetian confirmed Ms. Zhang’s response. Ms.
  Varpetian added that the Councilmember has been notified of Mr. Satoorian’s absence
  and that she hopes to have a more solid response by the next Committee meeting.

8.  NEW BUSINESS:

  None.

9.  ADJOURNMENT:

  Moved: Alex Parajon  Second: Ed Khashadourian

  Adjournment at 3:59 PM
